pr_decisions.title: chore(audit): Dependabot investigation run 67 — report + audit record (2026-06-13)
pr_decisions.reason: Docs-only — adds .audit-runs/dependabot-run-65/66/67-2026-06-13.json. 0 vulnerabilities, 0 native Dependabot PRs, 7 deferred packages unchanged. No code changes, zero risk. Safe to merge.
Superseded by PR #208 (merged in Run 63) — run 60 record is already in main.

deferred_packages.name: wouter
deferred_packages.reason: Active patches/wouter@3.7.1.patch must be ported to 3.10.0 internals first. Confirmed unchanged since Run 67.

deferred_packages.name: @types/express
deferred_packages.reason: v5 types require Express 5 runtime; breaks TypeScript with v4. Must pair with express upgrade.

deferred_packages.name: @types/node
deferred_packages.reason: Node 25 types on Node 22 runtime causes false type-safety. Runtime must be upgraded first.

deferred_packages.name: express
deferred_packages.reason: Named wildcards change, res.redirect() flip, dotfiles default changed. Node 18+ required (ok). Needs codemod: npx codemod@latest @expressjs/v5-migration-recipe. Dedicated migration branch needed.

deferred_packages.name: pnpm
deferred_packages.reason: Breaking: config no longer read from package.json pnpm field; only .npmrc. Store format changed to SQLite. minimumReleaseAge=1440 on by default. Docker/CI env var renames. Node 22+ required (ok). Needs config migration.

deferred_packages.name: puppeteer
deferred_packages.reason: Breaking (May 2026): executablePath() and defaultArgs() now return Promise instead of sync values — breaks server/pdfGenerator.ts. ESM-only. Node 22+ required (ok). Needs async refactor of resolveChromiumPath().

deferred_packages.name: typescript
deferred_packages.reason: Released March 23, 2026. 9 defaults changed: strict:true, types:[], target:ES2023, module:ESNext. Legacy module systems removed (amd/umd/systemjs/none). Escape valve: ignoreDeprecations:6.0 in compilerOptions. Dedicated migration branch needed.

key_breaks: types:[] now default (was all @types/*) — 20-50% build time improvement
module defaults to ESNext for new projects
moduleResolution defaults to bundler when module=ESNext
Legacy module options removed: amd, umd, systemjs, none
Config no longer read from package.json pnpm field
Store index replaced by SQLite database
minimumReleaseAge defaults to 1440 (1 day) — supply chain protection
static middleware dotfiles option defaults to ignore
MIME: JS files return text/javascript instead of application/javascript

notes: All packages fully up-to-date or deferred with documented blockers. pnpm audit clean (0 vulns, 775 deps). 0 native Dependabot bot PRs confirmed via GitHub API (author:app/dependabot = 0 results).
